mapper.select: select count(*) from user_log where action_time >= curdate()

select date_format(from_unixtime(borrow_time / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') as `date`, count(*) as `count` from borrow_info where from_unixtime(borrow_time / 1000) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 13 day) group by date_format(from_unixtime(borrow_time / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') order by date_format(from_unixtime(borrow_time / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d')
select book_name as `name`, count(*) as `value` from borrow_info group by book_id, book_name order by `value` desc, book_id asc limit 8
select book_name as `name`, stock as `value` from book order by stock desc, book_id asc limit 8
select r.role_name as `name`, count(*) as `value` from user_role ur join r_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id group by r.role_id, r.role_name order by `value` desc

select case action_type when 1 then '新增' when 2 then '修改' when 3 then '删除' when 4 then '上传' when 5 then '登录' when 6 then '退出' else '其他' end as `name`, count(*) as `value` from user_log group by action_type order by `value` desc
select date_format(action_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `time`, user_name as `userName`, description from user_log order by action_time desc limit 8
